senses.en: the final part or furthest point of something
to stop, or cause something to stop
a purpose that someone wants to achieve

ex.en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
ex.zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。

ex.en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。

col: a means to an end｜达到目的的手段
tip: at the end指末尾；in the end指最终。

senses.en: Having a very pleasant taste.

ex.en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
ex.zh: 这份美味的蔬菜派刚出炉，还热乎着。

ex.en: School meals should be both nutritious and delicious to encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 学校餐食应兼顾营养与美味，以鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: delicious本身语气较强，常用absolutely加强。

senses.en: Make or become full
Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
ex.zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。

ex.en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

col: fill in a form｜填写表格
fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true.
A strong desire for something to happen or be true.
To express hope for someone's happiness or success.

ex.en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
ex.zh: 要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。

ex.en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
ex.zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。

col: wish to do something｜希望做某事
tip: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

senses.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
ex.zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。

col: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex.zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

ex.en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。

col: become increasingly important｜变得日益重要
tip: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

ex.en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

senses.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.
A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment.
Having a pale yellowish-white colour.

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
ex.zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。

ex.en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
ex.zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。

tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

senses.en: websites and apps where people share things online

ex.en: She shares photos of her dog on social media.
ex.zh: 她在社交媒体上分享她的狗的照片。

ex.en: Social media helps us keep in touch with friends.
ex.zh: 社交媒体帮助我们和朋友保持联系。

tip: social media 是社交媒体，如微博、微信朋友圈等平台。
scene: A smartphone showing social media posts with hearts and comments.

senses.en: the good or bad things that happen by chance

ex.en: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
ex.zh: 祝你明天考试好运！

ex.en: She had no luck finding a parking space.
ex.zh: 她运气不好，没找到停车位。

tip: good luck 是祝福语；lucky 是形容词“幸运的”。
scene: A four-leaf clover lying on a desk next to a good luck card.

senses.en: Towards or in a higher position.
Towards a higher point or further along something.
Awake and out of bed.

ex.en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
ex.zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。

ex.en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。

tip: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。

senses.en: The earth and all the people and things on it.
A particular area of activity and the people involved.

ex.en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
ex.zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。

ex.en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
ex.zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。

tip: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

senses.en: many different types of something

ex.en: The market sells all kinds of fruit and vegetables.
ex.zh: 这个市场卖各种各样的水果和蔬菜。

ex.en: People use computers for all kinds of things.
ex.zh: 人们用电脑做各种各样的事情。

tip: all kinds of 后面接可数名词复数或不可数名词。
scene: A busy market stall piled with many different kinds of fruit.

senses.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

ex.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
ex.zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。

ex.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

tip: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

senses.en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
ex.zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it
to consume alcoholic beverages

ex.en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
ex.zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。

ex.en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
ex.zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。

tip: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

senses.en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.

ex.en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
ex.zh: 这根胡萝卜的形状很特别，像一只小手。

ex.en: Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究可能与全球气温上升有关的异常天气模式。

col: an unusual feature｜不寻常的特征
tip: It is unusual for sb to do表示某人很少这样做。

senses.en: A computer program designed for a particular task.

ex.en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
ex.zh: 这个应用程序每周日提醒我给植物浇水。

ex.en: A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.
ex.zh: 语言学习应用可以提供价格低廉的练习机会，但无法完全取代与教师的互动。

col: download an app｜下载应用程序
install an app｜安装应用程序
language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

senses.en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns.
A large amount, without naming what is being discussed.
To a great degree, especially with comparisons and certain verbs.

ex.en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。

tip: 修饰不可数名词；可数名词复数用many。

senses.en: an office where tourists get maps and advice

ex.en: We got a city map at the tourist information centre.
ex.zh: 我们在游客信息中心拿到了一张城市地图。

ex.en: The tourist information centre is open every day.
ex.zh: 游客信息中心每天开放。

tip: 游客信息中心提供地图、路线建议等服务。
scene: A tourist information centre with an i sign and a visitor getting a map.

senses.en: An Australian mammal with powerful hind legs; females carry pouch young.

ex.en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
ex.zh: 一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。

ex.en: Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
ex.zh: 栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。

col: a kangaroo's pouch｜袋鼠的育儿袋
tip: 复数直接加-s：kangaroos；育儿袋叫pouch。

senses.en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another
a process of personal change or development over time
to travel from one place to another

ex.en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。

ex.en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。

col: a journey of discovery｜探索之旅
make a journey｜进行一次旅行
tip: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

senses.en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience.
To find out information about something.

ex.en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
ex.zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。

ex.en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
ex.zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
tip: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

senses.en: A small bag for carrying personal items, typically used by women.

ex.en: She found her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
ex.zh: 她在手提包底部找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce waste by choosing a durable handbag rather than replacing inexpensive accessories every season.
ex.zh: 消费者可以选择耐用的手提包，而不是每季更换廉价配饰，从而减少浪费。

tip: 美式常用purse指女式手袋；英式purse通常指零钱包。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in, towards, or facing the south
towards or in the south

ex.en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。

ex.en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。

tip: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

senses.en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift
Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity
Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty

ex.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。

ex.en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。

tip: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

senses.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances.
To preserve food by sealing it in cans.

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
ex.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

senses.en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages.
A friendly, informal conversation.

ex.en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。

ex.en: Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.
ex.zh: 社区花园让邻居能够经常闲聊，有助于加深彼此的关系，减少社交孤立。

tip: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

ex.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

col: hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

senses.en: informal word for grandfather

ex.en: Grandpa tells funny stories about his childhood.
ex.zh: 爷爷讲他童年时的趣事。

ex.en: My grandpa grows vegetables in the garden.
ex.zh: 我爷爷在花园里种蔬菜。

tip: grandpa 是 grandfather 的口语说法。
scene: A grandfather watering vegetables in a garden with a watering can.

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
ex.zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！

ex.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
ex.zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

tip: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

senses.en: One of four equal parts of something.
A period of three months within a year.
An area of a town with a particular character.

ex.en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
ex.zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。

ex.en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。

col: a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟
tip: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

senses.en: A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.

ex.en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
ex.zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。

ex.en: Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.
ex.zh: 减少可乐等含糖饮料的摄入，可能有助于预防儿童龋齿。

col: a can of cola｜一罐可乐
tip: 泛指饮料时不可数；a cola可指一杯或一份可乐。

senses.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
A short period of rain
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
ex.zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
ex.zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

senses.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.

ex.en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
ex.zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。

tip: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

senses.en: something that belongs to me

ex.en: This bicycle is mine, not yours.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车是我的，不是你的。

ex.en: My phone is black and hers is white. Wait, mine is blue.
ex.zh: 我的手机是黑色的，她的是白色的。等等，我的是蓝色的。

tip: mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: A blue bicycle standing in front of a school bike rack.

senses.en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

ex.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
ex.zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。

ex.en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
ex.zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。

tip: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

senses.en: having a thin, often attractive shape
very small in amount or likelihood
to lose weight or reduce something in size

ex.en: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
ex.zh: 这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。

tip: 形容身材多含褒义；slim chance指机会渺茫。

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。

ex.en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
ex.zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。

tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

senses.en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group.
Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
ex.zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。

ex.en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
ex.zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

tip: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

senses.en: to copy data from the internet onto your device
the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way

ex.en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。

ex.en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
ex.zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

senses.en: An adult male human
Human beings considered collectively
To provide people to operate or guard something

ex.en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
ex.zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。

ex.en: Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.
ex.zh: 该市举办一年一度的文化节期间，需要更多志愿者在咨询台值守。

col: man a desk｜在服务台值守
man a checkpoint｜在检查站执勤
tip: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

senses.en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.

ex.en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
ex.zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。

tip: frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。

senses.en: used when an animal or thing does something to itself

ex.en: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光下给自己梳理毛发。

ex.en: The door closes by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己会关上。

tip: by itself 表示“自动地/独自地”，如门自动关上。
scene: A cat licking its paw while sitting in a sunny window.

senses.en: the name shared by members of a family

ex.en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
ex.zh: 陌生人常常觉得我的姓很难念。

ex.en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
ex.zh: 不同文化的命名传统各不相同，一个人的姓氏可能反映其家族历史或地域来源。

tip: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

senses.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
Before the expected time or near the beginning

ex.en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。

ex.en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
ex.zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。

tip: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
ex.zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。

ex.en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

ex.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
ex.zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。

ex.en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
ex.zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。

tip: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

senses.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically.
An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。

ex.en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。

col: program a computer｜给计算机编程
tip: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

senses.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop
An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information
Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。

ex.en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
ex.zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

col: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象
tip: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: For each unit of something.

ex.en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
ex.zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。

ex.en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。

tip: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react
the chemical properties and processes of a substance
a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
ex.zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。

ex.en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
ex.zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。

tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

senses.en: more than usual, or more than other people or things

ex.en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
ex.zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。

tip: especially强调“尤其”；specially常指“专门地”。

senses.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.
Fully grown, or relating to grown people.

ex.en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
ex.zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。

ex.en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。

tip: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

col: protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
ex.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。

ex.en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
ex.zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。

tip: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.en: to take something back to where it was

ex.en: Please bring back my book tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天把我的书带回来。

ex.en: She brought back some gifts from her trip.
ex.zh: 她旅行带回来一些礼物。

tip: bring back 和 take back 都表示“带回”，bring 强调带回来，take 强调带走。
scene: A girl handing a book back to her friend at school.

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

senses.en: small British money; 100 pence in a pound

ex.en: The sweets cost fifty pence.
ex.zh: 这些糖果五十便士。

ex.en: I have one pound and twenty pence.
ex.zh: 我有一英镑二十便士。

tip: pence 是 penny 的复数（金额时用），如 20 pence。
scene: A handful of British coins on a shop counter.

senses.en: a place where you buy petrol for cars

ex.en: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the car.
ex.zh: 我们在加油站停车加油。

ex.en: The petrol station is open all night.
ex.zh: 这家加油站通宵营业。

tip: petrol station 是英式说法；美式说 gas station。
scene: A car being filled with fuel at a petrol station with a price sign.

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
ex.zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。

ex.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
ex.zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。

tip: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

senses.en: to direct your eyes towards something

ex.en: Look at the picture and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 看这幅图并回答问题。

ex.en: He looked at the clock and hurried out.
ex.zh: 他看了看钟，匆匆出去了。

tip: look at 是“看着某物”；watch 是“注视动态画面”，如看电视。
scene: A student looking closely at a picture book at a desk.

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

senses.en: Not at any time.
Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.

ex.en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
ex.zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。

ex.en: Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.
ex.zh: 作为方便易行的日常运动方式，步行和骑行永远无法被公共交通完全取代。

tip: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

senses.en: The time around the middle of the day when people eat.

ex.en: At lunchtime, we sat outside and shared some sandwiches.
ex.zh: 午餐时，我们坐在外面分着吃了一些三明治。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces at lunchtime may help employees relax and return to work with greater focus.
ex.zh: 在午餐时间提供安静的空间，可能有助于员工放松，并在重返工作时更加专注。

col: a lunchtime walk｜午餐时段的散步
tip: 表示“在午餐时间”通常用at lunchtime。

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
ex.zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

ex.en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
ex.zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。

tip: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: 成功的人或事物；受益者
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

ex.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
ex.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

tip: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

col: easy access to｜便于获取或到达……
tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.zh: 无线网络；无线联网技术
senses.en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

ex.en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。

ex.en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
ex.zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。

tip: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

senses.en: extra and available to use when needed
to give time or resources that you can make available
to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty

ex.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
ex.zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。

ex.en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
ex.zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

col: spare a moment｜抽出一点时间
tip: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

senses.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea
to form words with your lips without making a sound

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
ex.zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。

ex.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
ex.zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。

col: the mouth of a river｜河口
tip: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

senses.en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings
Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret

ex.en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
ex.zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。

ex.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
ex.zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

tip: 衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。

senses.en: a document that proves who you are

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

ex.en: Please show your ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口出示证件。

tip: ID 是 identification 的缩写，ID card 是身份证。
scene: A hand holding an ID card in front of a security desk.

senses.en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.
A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。

ex.en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。

col: a recent study｜最近的一项研究
study for an exam｜为考试学习
tip: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money
something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
ex.zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。

ex.en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。

col: the cost of living｜生活成本
at all costs｜不惜一切代价
tip: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。

ex.en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
ex.zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。

col: team player｜善于团队合作的人
tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

senses.en: informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Grandma bakes the best apple pie.
ex.zh: 奶奶烤的苹果派最好吃。

ex.en: We visited my grandma in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我们去乡下看望了外婆。

tip: grandma 是 grandmother 的口语说法；granny 也常用。
scene: A grandmother with grey hair baking an apple pie in a kitchen.

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

tip: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: a machine that plays CDs

ex.en: My old CD player still works well.
ex.zh: 我的旧光盘播放机还能用。

ex.en: She listened to music on her CD player.
ex.zh: 她用光盘播放机听音乐。

tip: 现在大家多用手机听歌，CD player 是较旧的设备。
scene: A small CD player on a shelf with headphones next to it.

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

col: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷
tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

senses.en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something
used to ask who something belongs to

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
ex.zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？

ex.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
ex.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

tip: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

senses.en: to exercise, or to find the answer

ex.en: She works out at the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 她每周去健身房锻炼三次。

ex.en: Can you work out the answer to this problem?
ex.zh: 你能算出这道题的答案吗？

tip: work out 有“锻炼、算出、解决”等多个意思。
scene: A person exercising on a treadmill at a gym.

senses.en: Limited in size, amount, or degree.
Young and not yet fully grown.
Not very important or serious.

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。
